notes.subject: Elihu o bitša bafeeledi
notes.rationale: Taellakgolo ya go theetša e bitša bafeeledi ba Job go theetša modumo wa Elohim

notes.subject: שמעו שמוע
notes.rationale: Poeleto ya leina-le-wo-a-sego-wa-mohuta (infinitive absolute) — go bolela gape go gatelela go theetša; go laleditšwe mo Sepedi ka go boelediša 'theetša'

notes.subject: ברגז
notes.rationale: Regoz e bolela tsogu/kgahlanong/moleta wa go gogela; mehlala ya pele e fapana: 'modumong wa go gogela' kgahlanong le 'maatlang a gagwe'

translation: Theetša, theetša ka tlhokomelo mo go tshikilegong ga lentšu la gagwe, gomme ⟨mokoko⟩ o tšwa molomong wa gagwe.
